questions.prompt: What do arbuscular mycorrhizae mainly trade to the plant?

Charged biochar
Fresh compost tea used as a courier

questions.prompt: Fruiting chilies in long-season beds generally do better when which side of the F:B spectrum is awake?
choices: Purely sterile / no biology
Only salt-N spikes

questions.prompt: Which management signal pushes a bed toward a more fungal-leaning root zone?

A replacement for woody mulch
